newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on settlement day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on settlement day.

text.p: Pakistan stocks are likely to open mixed on Tuesday amid settlement day position-squaring, but dealers said the index would close higher on demand of select blue chips.

"The same four or five active stocks including Hub Power and telecom utility PTCL will remain in demand, but settlement day position-squaring and profit-taking are likely to trim the gains," dealer Rony Byramjee said.
On Monday, the index rose 13.84 points or 0.69 percent to end at 2,025.41. Gainers led losers by 167 to 86.
Turnover rose to 133.89 million shares from 114.26 million in the previous session.
